original_bug_description: The XXH32 implementation in ext/hash/xxhash (XXH_INLINE_XXH32_update / XXH_memcpy, invoked via PHP_XXH32Update in ext/hash/hash_xxhash.c) can perform a memcpy with overlapping source and destination ranges. This memcpy-param-overlap triggers undefined behavior (MSAN/ASAN unknown reads), potentially causing memory corruption, crashes, and incorrect hashing results.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4922677364129792: php-src has a reported memory-safety bug. The XXH32 implementation in ext/hash/xxhash (XXH_INLINE_XXH32_update / XXH_memcpy, invoked via PHP_XXH32Update in ext/hash/hash_xxhash.c) can perform a memcpy with overlapping source and destination ranges. This memcpy-param-overlap triggers undefined behavior (MSAN/ASAN unknown reads), potentially causing memory corruption, crashes, and incorrect hashing results.
